# Mochikabu

Mochikabu is an open-source AI agent skill for Japanese employee stock ownership and employee shareholding plans (社員持株会 / 従業員持株会).

Primary purpose:
- evaluate the employer using public financial evidence;
- estimate DCF fair value and sensitivity;
- compare peer valuation metrics;
- model employee incentives, bonus contributions and dividend reinvestment;
- review employer-stock concentration and plan constraints;
- support increase / maintain / reduce / pause contribution decisions.

Important boundaries:
- monetary inputs and outputs are normalized to JPY;
- Japanese plan rules are plan-specific and are not assumed equivalent to US ESOP or ESPP rules;
- non-public employer information must not trigger a buy, sell or contribution increase;
- Mochikabu does not execute trades;
- missing or stale evidence remains OPEN or partial rather than being invented.

Canonical project:
